summary: Master financial planning for retirement with our comprehensive training course. Gain the skills to secure your future and achieve your retirement goals.
lede: Retirement planning training covers assessing retirement readiness, estimating income gaps, and planning how to sustain income while preserving wealth. For financial planners, wealth managers and other professionals advising on retirement, it builds practical skills in cash-flow forecasting, scenario modelling, asset allocation, disciplined withdrawals and tax-aware preservation, helping them prepare clear income strategies and review plans against changing assumptions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who advise on retirement readiness, portfolio preservation, and income sustainability.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic working knowledge of personal finance concepts, budgeting, savings products, and investment terminology. No coding is required. Comfort with spreadsheet use for cash flow tables, retirement calculators, and scenario analysis will help you complete the practical exercises more effectively.
